summary.tagline: Laponia, or the Laponian Area, is a large mountainous wildlife area in the Lapland province in northern Sweden

days.title: Eastern Forests and Bogs
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Muddus
stops.detail: The world heritage site includes four national parks (Muddus, Sarek, Padjelanta and Stora Sjöfallet) as well as the nature reserves Sjaunja, Stubba, Sulitelma, Tjuoltadalen and Rapadalen.

stops.name: Sjaunja
stops.detail: Further east, the boggy and forested foothills of the Scandes extend, which become flatter and flatter from Sjaunja to the Muddus area.

days.title: High Mountains and Deep Valleys
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Sarek
stops.detail: In Sarek – known for its deep U-shaped valleys – lie some of Sweden's highest mountains.

stops.name: Akkajaure
stops.detail: With the dam at Akkajaure, significant changes to the shoreline zone occurred, which has negative effects on the vegetation due to water level fluctuations (423–453 m).
